alalal-e78228-d1e101.summary: Rubric marking the second textual division of Distinction 23.

alalal-e78228-d1e108.summary: Divides Lombard's explanation of Augustine's definition ('Accipitur autem fides tribus modis') into five chapters: how faith is a virtue; the meaning of 'what is believed' ('Aliud est credere'); whether faith that is not a virtue can become one ('Si vero quaeritur'); the universality or unity of faith ('Cumque diversis modis'); and how faith concerns things not apparent ('Notandum quoque').

alalal-e78228.summary: Division of the second part of Distinction 23, in which Lombard explains Augustine's definition of faith in five chapters: how faith is a virtue, with the threefold sense of 'faith'; what it is to believe; whether faith that is not a virtue can become one; how faith is one though held in diverse ways; and how faith properly concerns things not apparent.
